narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Seventy two squared is seventy squared plus two squared, four thousand nine hundred four.
<bookmark mark='strips'/>The square of seventy two also holds two strips, each seventy by two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Leaving out the strips loses two hundred eighty, so that answer is too small.
